description: This file defines the DuplexPipeStream class, a custom Stream implementation that wraps a PipeReader and PipeWriter to facilitate duplex communication over a pipe. It provides synchronous and asynchronous read/write operations, as well as handling for disposal and buffer validation.

classes.name: DuplexPipeStream
classes.description: A custom stream implementation supporting duplex communication via an underlying pipe, enabling reading and writing with support for sync and async operations.

methods.name: CanRead
methods.description: Indicates the stream supports reading.

methods.name: CanSeek
methods.description: Indicates the stream does not support seeking.

methods.name: CanWrite
methods.description: Indicates the stream supports writing.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Throws NotSupportedException; length is not supported.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Throws NotSupportedException; position property is not supported.

methods.name: Constructo
methods.description: Initializes the DuplexPipeStream with a given IDuplexPipe.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources by completing the pipe reader and writer.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources by completing the pipe reader and writer.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Synchronously flushes the writer buffer.

methods.name: FlushAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously flushes the writer buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Synchronously reads data into a buffer.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data into a buffer with cancellation support.

methods.name: ReadAsync (Memory<byte>)
methods.description: Reads data into a Memory<byte> buffer asynchronously.

methods.name: BeginRead
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous read operation using the APM pattern.

methods.name: EndRead
methods.description: Ends an asynchronous read operation started with BeginRead.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Throws NotSupportedException; seeking is not supported.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Throws NotSupportedException; setting length is not supported.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Synchronously writes data from a buffer.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes data from a buffer with cancellation support.

methods.name: WriteAsync (ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)
methods.description: Writes data from a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer asynchronously.

methods.name: BeginWrite
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous write operation using the APM pattern.

methods.name: EndWrite
methods.description: Ends an asynchronous write operation started with BeginWrite.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Copies the remaining data from the PipeReader to a destination stream asynchronously.
